episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: It's sweeter than honey and clearer than spring water. It is more enticing than apples and deadlier than death.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: It lurks behind the dust on the ground and inside the heat of melted lead. It is everywhere.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: It goes forward along the temporal lobe, clinging to the sphenoid bone. It is murmuring.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: Perhaps it is destined to appear, like the ruins buried in desert. It has always been there, and its appearance is just a matter of time.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: Or maybe, it never existed: it could be just a common lie provided by the dream far, far away.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: It has tasted the sweetness of abundance. No other flavors are satisfying enough now.

episodes.name: Psychugram Analysis
episodes.desc: It is the lord as well as the slave of the leaf. It impels the flame deep in the vein to burn, to release the hardest passion.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: The messenger emptied the shoes of gravel to protect their feet from wear and bleeding.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: The rock-hard priest of the Sethmordians no longer exists. The great monolith with divine inscriptions was shattered by a meteor shower.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: The explorers of the new age were filled with hope and conquered numerous mountains.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: There will always be a higher peak and a taller mountain to climb. It exists south of the snow-locked apex and behind the imposing rock stratum.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: Turn left thrice, then turn right twice. Give a sincere prayer, elbow the dirt 14 times, and swallow a piece of clean snow.

episodes.name: Mountain Echos
episodes.desc: They finally reached the legendary hall. It exists within the rock beneath the broken peak. Within it lies another world.

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: Everyone thought the apocalypse arrived on the day the stars fell.

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: The rescue team hurried to the crash site and found something far beyond their imagination.

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: They are living a happy life. A really happy life! This dirt-poor, run-down town HAS NEVER FELT SO GOOD!

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: The naughty brat slept in silence. The poor woman looked well. The miserly old man proved to be kind. And the notorious thug was humble and polite.

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: The sun felt softer than suede and the wind was thicker than mead. One could smell diamonds while sugar grew from the nails. The rescuers removed their protective gear and laid down on the brocade ground.

episodes.name: Starfall Locale
episodes.desc: After 14 weeks, corpses of those who died of hunger, dehydration, and gastrointestinal obstruction began to pile up above the dark brown hill. The notebook was filled with insane writings praising the glorious hall that the writer dwelt in.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: People treat saplings as a symbol of life. Saplings also treat people the same way.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: When the druids wore their floral crowns, every bird and tree in the forest sang with them.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: They arrived at the lake on the 5th day of Spring and washed themselves with the lake water.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: Everything was meant for the Forest Festival and it shall arrive with the night.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: The hidden one of the oak forest wore a robe of woven thorns and vines. Ravens and eagles hovered beside it, while its crescent-like sickle felled trees like wheat.

episodes.name: Sylvanus Shape
episodes.desc: The hall of deep woods stood above the crescent and beneath the shade of the tree. Within it lies fire, life, death, and rebirth.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: The feral child raised by the pack does not know how to stand or the meaning of poetry, songs, or basic manners.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: The humans abandoned him. And they took him in again. The beast mother watched in silence as the car drove away.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: Their lantern-like eyes remain forever lit in moonless midnights.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: "Don't show compassion to the wail in the wilderness, children." said the people who built the iron cages.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: Claw marks cover the performance troupe posters. Beast fur is scattered throughout the audience seating. The wolf child's legend has ended. He no longer had to fear those flashing boxes.

episodes.name: Brutes Wilds
episodes.desc: No book could describe the language of the feral pack. They lived in the corridors where vipers and rabbits lived with each other, where lions and lambs slept in peace. The she-wolf finally regained her lost cub.
